first_label: V1 is the first label in the insertion permutation; uniform on all five sites, including the inert isolate
terminal_time: T is the first insertion completing any edge
new_readout: E[T|V1] and the covariance across V1 of the whole conditional survival vector P(T>k|V1), k=0..5
clock_variance: Var(T), not variance over vertex means; exact first-label fraction Var(E[T|V1])/Var(T)
arithmetic: all 5!=120 permutations per fixed graph, exact integer/Fraction arithmetic; no random samples
